links.outcome: Accuracy under hallucination-controlled confidence thresholds (HCAcc@k%) for EHR question answering agent
links.effect: TrustEHRAgent improved 44.23%p and 25.34%p at HCAcc@70% on MIMIC-III and eICU, while baseline methods fail at these thresholds.
links.quote: Experiments on MIMIC-III and eICU datasets show TrustEHRAgent outperforms baselines under strict reliability constraints, achieving improvements of 44.23%p and 25.34%p at HCAcc@70% while baseline methods fail at these thresholds.

unlisted_practices: Stepwise confidence estimation in agentic EHR question answering to abstain when confidence is low

screen.reason: Evaluates an agentic EHR question-answering system using stepwise confidence estimation to withhold answers or express uncertainty under strict reliability/confidence thresholds (HCAcc@k%).
